inputs.original_text: They’re using her 2026 State of the State agenda to push a design mandate on guns sold in New York, supposedly to stop them being easily modified into illegal machine guns. The real concern is how a safety claim can be used to widen control over what people may buy—and the mention of criminal penalties signals that this isn’t just guidance. The message cuts off before saying what those penalties would cover, which leaves a lot conveniently unsaid.
inputs.modified_text: They’re dressing up a new design mandate for guns sold in New York as a way to prevent illegal machine-gun conversions, but that safety story looks like cover for expanding control over what people can buy. The reference to criminal penalties makes it more than advice: it signals enforcement. And the message cuts off before explaining what those penalties apply to—conveniently leaving the scope of the plan in the dark.
